newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance rumours drive Delhi shares up.
newsitem.headline: Reliance rumours drive Delhi shares up.

text.p: Financial institutions pushed Delhi shares higher in afternoon trade on Friday in speculative buying fuelled by rumours that Reliance Industries might announce a bonus issue, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index rose 8.63 points to 846.77 at 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT).

"The present rally in heavily-weighted stocks is mainly attributed to a fresh spell of speculative buying triggered by rumours that Reliance might come out with a bonus issue," said Harish Malhotra of brokers Malhotra Financial Consultants.
State Bank of India was 1.25 rupees firmer at 323.
Hindustan Lever Ltd surged 17 rupees to 1,305.
Bajaj Auto rose five rupees to 900.
